blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A defense witness acknowledged the need for further investigation into the P2.7 billion worth of bank transactions involving Vice President Sara Duterte from 2009 to 2013. During Thursday’s impeachment trial, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian confronted the defense witness, lawyer and certified public accountant Rainer Dela Fuente, with transaction figures he cited from Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) records, alongside income information provided by the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR). Gatchalian said the AMLC had submitted yearly transaction volumes and values covering 2007 to 2025. He focused on the P2.7-billion cluster during the five years he identified. For 2009 alone, […]...
